anchor: The Endless Surge begins around the still relatively small central Tear, raw Tear-magic critically wounds and leaves the First Speaker unconscious, Velmora loses central coordination, and a variable conflict begins over who will replace him.
Velmora survives the initial disaster and establishes temporary emergency order while the central Tear continues growing and the player advances two faction paths.
The expanding Tear releases higher forms of magic, beings, and creatures into Velmora, reshaping the city around the player's established path and the approaches to the Tear that remain possible.

The player reaches the source of the Endless Surge inside Velmora, chooses among the apocalypse truths their actions kept possible, and determines the final condition of the Tear, the six factions, and the city.
